description: Na₆U₂Mo₄O₂₁ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with three MoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.65 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.81 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.85 Å. U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and corners with four MoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-62°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.85 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-61°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.86 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃Mo tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one U, and one Mo atom to form distorted ONa₂UMo tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mo tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂UMo tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one U, and one Mo atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one Mo atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent U atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom.
